note: How a traveler hands in each visa application themselves (CMPS271-72). Links are official pages only. The fee and decision time come from visa_guides.json.

schengen-short-stay.form: Download the filled Schengen application form from the official form section on this page, check every field, then print it and sign it by hand.
schengen-short-stay.booking: Book an appointment at the consulate of your main destination, or at the visa centre it uses (often VFS Global or TLScontact). Apply at least 15 days, and at most 6 months, before you travel.

booking_link.label: The EU's guide to applying for a Schengen visa

schengen-short-stay.hand_in: At the appointment, hand in your signed form and documents, pay the fee, and give your fingerprints and a photo unless they were taken in the last 59 months.
schengen-short-stay.collect: The consulate keeps your passport while it decides, then returns it with the visa or a refusal letter.

uk-standard-visitor.form: Fill in the online application on GOV.UK, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, then pay the fee online.
uk-standard-visitor.booking: After paying, book a biometrics appointment at the visa application centre for your country (TLScontact or VFS Global).

booking_link.label: GOV.UK: apply for a Standard Visitor visa

uk-standard-visitor.hand_in: At the appointment, give your fingerprints and photo and hand in or upload your supporting documents.
uk-standard-visitor.collect: Your passport is returned with the visa, or a letter explaining a refusal.

us-b2-tourist.form: Fill in the DS-160 online, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, and print the confirmation page.
us-b2-tourist.booking: Pay the fee and book your visa interview at the US embassy or consulate on the official scheduling site.

booking_link.label: US Department of State: visitor visa

us-b2-tourist.hand_in: Go to the interview with your passport, the DS-160 confirmation page, the fee receipt and your documents. The officer decides at or after the interview.
us-b2-tourist.collect: If approved, the embassy returns your passport with the visa by courier or for collection.

canada-visitor.form: Apply online with an IRCC account, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, and pay the fee and biometrics fee.
canada-visitor.booking: After you get the biometrics instruction letter, book an appointment at a visa application centre.

booking_link.label: Government of Canada: apply for a visitor visa

canada-visitor.hand_in: At the appointment, give your fingerprints and photo with the instruction letter and your passport.
canada-visitor.collect: If approved, IRCC asks for your passport to place the visa, then returns it.

japan-short-stay.form: Fill in the visa application form, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, print it and sign it.
japan-short-stay.booking: Check with the Embassy of Japan in your country, or the agency it designates, how to hand in the application and whether you need an appointment.

booking_link.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan: visa

japan-short-stay.hand_in: Hand in the signed form, your passport, a photo and your documents in person.
japan-short-stay.collect: Collect your passport on the date the embassy gives you.

china-tourist-l.form: Fill in the online visa application form, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, then print and sign it.
china-tourist-l.booking: Book an appointment at the Chinese Visa Application Service Center, or the embassy, for your country.
china-tourist-l.hand_in: Hand in the signed form, your passport and documents, give your fingerprints if asked, and pay the fee.
china-tourist-l.collect: Collect your passport with the visa on the date you're given.

india-tourist.form: Apply for the e-Visa on the official website, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, upload your photo and passport page, and pay online.
india-tourist.booking: The e-Visa needs no appointment. Keep the application ID so you can check its status.
india-tourist.hand_in: When it's granted, print the e-Visa and carry it with your passport when you travel.
india-tourist.collect: The e-Visa arrives by email; show it with your passport on arrival in India.

turkiye-evisa.form: Apply on the official e-Visa website, copying each value from the official form guide on this page, and pay online.
turkiye-evisa.booking: The e-Visa needs no appointment. Use only the official website.
turkiye-evisa.hand_in: Download and print the e-Visa as soon as it's issued.
turkiye-evisa.collect: Carry the printed e-Visa with your passport, and show it when you arrive.
